location_description: Chincoteague ( or ) is a town in Accomack County, Virginia, U.S.  The town includes the whole of Chincoteague Island and an area of adjacent water.  The population was 2,941 at the 2010 census. The town is known for the Chincoteague Ponies, although these are not actually on the island of Chincoteague but on nearby Assateague Island.
